name: Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side: 4th Heart
original_name: ときめきメモリアル Girl's Side 4th Heart
source:
In the beautiful Habataki City which is surrounded by the sea and mountains, a new life begins at Habataki Academy, a prestigious school whose philosophy is celebrating youth. Experience a new crush in this place where unique students and teachers meet.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.konami.com/games/girls_side/4th_teaser/index.html]official website[/url]]

The newest installment in the Girl's Side franchise, which supposes a return to Habataki Academy.
translation:
在依山傍海的美丽城市振翅市，你将在以讴歌青春为办学理念的名校——振翅学园，开启全新的生活。在这个个性鲜明的学生与老师齐聚一堂的地方，体验新的心动吧。

[译编自[url=https://www.konami.com/games/girls_side/4th_teaser/index.html]官方网站[/url]]

本作是《心跳回忆Girl's Side》系列的最新作品，舞台再次回到振翅学园。
